scope: Visible outcomes; editor chooses native implementation. Source weak geometry, bars, strip and part counts are not locks.

criteria.outcome: A low, broad, solid stone shelf with a clear finished east termination. Main crown has confident softened plate volume rather than an unrelieved box; decorations support the volume and stay inside its actual finite envelope.

The west port meets the exact approved middle as one surface in all four authored facings: no gap, doubled edge, conspicuous step, band, abrupt normal/color break or exposed cap. Finite original end/ground remains separate from the join.
Cyan and blue midtones carry the object, with deeper-blue recesses and restrained compatible accents. Neither lower side nor joined region becomes an unreadable black patch.

Broad soft light describes stone planes and rounded edges with bounded pale highlights; comparable cardinal facings have balanced material reading. No preferred horizontal key, ground cast shadow, bloom or alpha halo.
Stone boundaries, modest crafted erosion/pits or restrained accents look purposeful. Recesses have readable width and volume without random thin-line noise, floating trim or glare that erases form.

Every view reads cleanly at logical cell128 and phone cell32 on light/gray/dark. Enlarged views expose no clipping, self-overlap, coplanar cracks, black voids, open end, chipped join, filter fringe or alpha band.

approvalPolicy: Missing visual/native evidence is needs_evidence. No numeric-only seam waiver; quantify broad finite-area-light RGB residual separately from local join defects. Approval is candidate-specific and not available at preparation stage.
